verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: webhooks that push asynchronous status updates, a Management API for programmatic terminal ordering under an "automating terminal management" section, and an MCP server for natural-language access. These are primitives a developer could use to build automations, not a product feature for setting up autonomous background automations, so they earn no credit.
